🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Energy/Utilities/Industrials leading while Technology, Communication and Consumer Discretionary are weak — mixed signals support a neutral posture; Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +7.36% | 1M: +10.28%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities strong: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials also positive: LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, HON (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Discretionary, Communication and Technology are lagging this week — TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -11.63% | 1M: -7.67%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND; sector breadth is weak overall (3/11 positive).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND, HON (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +8.44% | 1M: -1.16%) RECOVERY — Leadership: Broad (Utilities/Industrials/Materials).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -17.48% | 1M: -17.65%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -11.63% | 1M: -7.67%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -11.60% | 1M: -4.17%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-growth Tech and select Consumer Discretionary names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Largest 1W momentum: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR DIVERGENCE across large caps (AAPL, MSFT, META, GOOGL showing 1W vs 1M mismatch) — watch for trend breaks and treat moves as tactical, not necessarily structural.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is under pressure and internally mixed: NVDA (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.36%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +9.30%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -4.87% | 1M: +2.04%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND — sector weakness this week confirms rotation away from large-cap Tech.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials show pockets of resilience but not leadership this week: JPM (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND while V (1W: -3.71% | 1M: +7.04%) CORRECTION and MA (1W: -3.85% | 1M: +8.83%) CORRECTION — sector breadth is mixed, so selection within Financials matters.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is mixed with defensive names holding up: JNJ (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +8.44%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +7.12%) ABOVE TREND while ISRG (1W: -17.48% | 1M: -17.65%) BELOW TREND — monitor idiosyncratic risk in device/biotech names.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor value/cyclical exposure given Energy and Industrials leadership (e.g., XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +8.44% | 1M: -1.16%) RECOVERY) and reduce exposure to names showing CORRECTION or BELOW TREND in Tech (GOOGL, MSFT, META). Given the MAJOR DIVERGENCE across large caps, treat new trends as tactical until confirmed.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, RTX (1W: +7.61% | 1M: +12.22%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -8.79% | 1M: +7.81%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy and Industrials (sector breadth driving price leadership; Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive overall). BEARISH: Technology and Communication (large-cap Tech weakness and Media/Comm pressure).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA for hold above recent swing lows to maintain its ABOVE TREND behavior; GOOGL breaking further below its 1M trend would signal deeper Tech rotation; XOM sustaining weekly strength would confirm Energy continuation; TSLA failing to stabilize after a steep weekly drop keeps downside risk elevated.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
RTX (+85): RTX (1W: +7.61% | 1M: +12.22%) ABOVE TREND — Q2 beat and raised outlook, price confirms sentiment. NOW (+80): NOW (1W: -11.60% | 1M: -4.17%) BELOW TREND — upbeat guidance/forecast but price is diverging, watch for distribution vs. follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
GOOGL (-50): GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND — negative AI capex headlines align with sharp price weakness. META (-50): META (1W: -8.79% | 1M: +7.81%) CORRECTION — debt/AI cost headlines add risk while 1M strength suggests potential short-term selling exhaustion. TSLA (-45): TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND — negative commentary on robotaxi execution aligns with pronounced downside.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Value/Cyclical style. XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND and VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND showing strength. Key risk: Major divergence across large-cap Tech (GOOGL, META, AAPL, MSFT) and mixed news sentiment (RTX confirming, NOW diverging) — watch for trend confirmation before expanding beta.
